title: Friday Quick Tip
subtitle: Big game nerves
hook: Your team is nervous before the big game. What do you say?
statement: Nerves mean kids care. They need help using them.
q1: Do you talk about the nerves openly —
q2: or keep things light and not mention them?
q3: What helped you feel calm at their age?
t1: There is no single right way. But teams settle
t2: when nerves are treated as normal.
cta: Coaches — how do you handle nerves?
ctaLines: Name it. Joke around. A familiar warm-up.
Talk about it or keep it light?
ctaPrompt: Share your pre-game habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
Your team is nervous before the big game. What do you say?
Warm-ups are quiet. Some players look pale.
Nerves mean kids care. They need help using them.
Talk about nerves or keep things light. There is no perfect answer.
How do you handle nerves? Share your habit in the comments.
